title: Beyond the 956: Melissa Rycroft-Strickland arrested for second DWI after ambulance hit-and-run in Southlake
excerpt: Melissa Rycroft-Strickland, 43, was arrested after Southlake police say she struck a fire department ambulance and left the scene on Halloween evening. No injuries were reported.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Former Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader and reality television star Melissa Rycroft-Strickland, 43, was arrested after Southlake police say she struck a Southlake Fire Department ambulance and left the scene on Halloween evening.

According to the Southlake Police Department, officers responded at about 5:50 p.m. on Saturday, October 31, to a reported hit-and-run collision involving the ambulance. Police say the ambulance was stopped at a stop sign when another vehicle struck it and left the scene. No injuries were reported.

Officers located the driver a short time later and identified her as Rycroft-Strickland, a Southlake resident. She was charged with driving while intoxicated, second offense; accident involving damage of more than $200; and driving with an invalid license.

She was booked into the Keller Regional Detention Facility, where jail records listed a combined bond of $9,000.

Rycroft-Strickland appeared on season 13 of The Bachelor and later won the all-star season of Dancing With the Stars. The new charges are allegations, and she is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

The arrest comes about two months after she pleaded guilty to a separate DWI charge stemming from a September 2025 arrest in Southlake. In August 2026, she was sentenced to 20 months of probation in that earlier case.

Sources: Southlake Police Department; USA Today; Oxygen; People.
